records.rule: no mate; net material +4 (before your move), +4 vs Stockfish's best line, doesn't reach -2 on both
records.explanation: Qd1 dropped your Win% from 51 to 32. In Stockfish's lines, e3 (+0.1) trades a bishop for a knight; your Qd1 (-2.2) wins a knight and a pawn. e3 ends with less material, so what it gains is in the position, which only Stockfish's score measures. e3 protects the pawn on d4. Your Qd1 protects the pawn on d4; Stockfish answers e5, which puts a pawn in the centre on e5 and attacks the bishop on f4.

records.rule: after the move Stockfish has mate in 1 against you (before: none)
records.explanation: a3 allowed mate in 1. In Stockfish's lines, g3 (-0.5) keeps the material level; your a3 (mated in 1) gets you checkmated. g3 attacks the queen on h4. Your a3 attacks the bishop on b4; Stockfish answers Qxf2#, which takes the pawn on f2 and is checkmate.
